<DOCUMENT>Now Assist Admin Console Configure monitor and troubleshoot Now Assist applications and skills This includes assigning models at the skill level tracking usage and providing visibility into system behavior Now Assist Skill Kit Equip developers with tools to build and evaluate custom generative AI skills Now Assist Data Kit Enable developers to manage datasets and create evaluation collections to support custom skill development and testing workflows AI Agent Studio Offer a nocode interface for designing and managing AI Agents Developers can define roles assign tools and connect agents to existing workflows using natural language configuration November 2025 Release Zurich 29</DOCUMENT>
<DOCUMENT>The customers security team should work with stakeholders to thoroughly assess the regulatory and organizational requirements for data stored in their ServiceNow instances to determine if data at rest needs to be encrypted Based on this assessment customers should select the most appropriate encryption method offered by ServiceNow When implementing the chosen encryption method ensure encryption settings and key management are configured in accordance with internal policies and compliance standards to safeguard sensitive information throughout its lifecycle Customers seeking included functionality Field Encryption Starter Data stored within a ServiceNow instance can be protected with Field Encryption Starter which allows customers to encrypt specific fields within the instance using AES128 or AES256 encryption The key itself is stored within the instance and is protected via the ServiceNow AI Platform using Key Management Framework</DOCUMENT>
<DOCUMENT>It is recommended that customers limit the use of personal identities for executing unattended automations or integrations By implementing ServiceNow access policy restrictions to clearly separate these data flows organizations can better define and uphold policies aligned with their identity architecture Use security attributes when possible Customers should utilize applicable security attributes when possible Security attributes offer an alternative method for access control via role definitions Use security data filters when possible Security data filters enable access restriction to records based on a users role or other security attributerelated assertions Security data filters are applied before a query is executed and ensure only authorized users can view records regardless of how data is accessed Customers should explicitly enable security data filters for userfacing queries that are not using GlideRecordSecure</DOCUMENT>

Customers seeking enhanced data protection can license additional encryption features Platform Encryption Bundle Combines Field Encryption Enterprise Cloud Encryption and the Key Management Framework KMF for comprehensive encryption coverage Field Encryption Enterprise Enables granular fieldlevel encryption with flexible policies API support and customermanaged key capabilities Cloud Encryption CE Provides volumelevel encryption supporting customer managed keys Full Disk Encryption FDE Encrypts physical disks at the hardware layer and requires dedicated hosting infrastructure ServiceNow encryption options can be used individually or in combination November 2025 Release Zurich 26

Administrators should collaborate closely with their organizations security teams to define the appropriate scope and duration for any scheduled penetration tests Once testing is complete administrators and security personnel must coordinate to review any findings prioritize remediation efforts and establish clear timelines to address findings Additional information Penetration test summary reports Customer penetration testing policy ServiceNow CORE Compliance Portal Directory Requires access to the ServiceNow CORE Compliance Portal Find out how to access CORE here November 2025 Release Zurich 40

It is important for customers to set password policies for their Identity Provider IdP and within their ServiceNow instances This includes specifying requirements like minimum password length complexity expiration uniqueness and lockout conditions for native accounts Also be sure configurations meet your organizational standards Enable account lockout to prevent brute force attacks As a critical security best practice customers should enable account lockouts both on their IdP and for all local accounts within the ServiceNow instance This measure is essential to defend against brute force authentication attacks by automatically locking accounts after a set number of failed login attempts Manage IP address access control Limit which IP addresses are allowed or denied access to the ServiceNow instance If a VPN or another method is used to route traffic through a known set of IP addresses access to the instance should only be allowed for that range of addresses
